NIPPO

中国共产党对日本及国民党拟采取之政策

以下是一位名为史沫特莱的美国女记者与共产党领袖毛泽东之间对话的性质，内容涉及中国共产党未来对日本和国民党拟采取的政策：
史沫特莱小姐——共产党目前采取的统一战线政策，与你去年秋天向记者埃德加·斯诺描述的政策有根本不同吗？
毛泽东——没有区别。
1) 我们的统一战线是为了抵抗日本。我们不反对所有帝国主义，只反对正在侵略中国的特定帝国主义。我们在反日运动中寻求英国、美国、法国和苏联的同情，并努力与这些国家培养友谊。
2) 我们的统一战线是民族性的。这意味着它包括除汉奸以外的所有党派和所有阶层的人士。有些人说共产党正在倡导人民阵线，但这是一个错误。共产党的统一战线是民族统一战线，而不是像在西班牙所倡导的那种人民统一战线。
3) 以下是抗日民族统一战线的重要目标：
a) 和平与统一。
b) 对日作战。
c) 人民自由。
d) 南京政府接纳所有党派，并罢免亲日官员。
e) 改革政府行政，实行普选制并建立人民共和国。
f) 改善民生。
g) 改善工商业。
h) 与同情中国抗日的国家合作。
史沫特莱小姐——为了完成抗日民族统一战线，你们做出了哪些牺牲？
毛泽东——1927年夏，国民党放弃了国共两党的统一战线，以及已故孙中山博士所采纳的中苏合作政策，从而使共产党承担起国民革命的责任。自那时起，共产党便与苏联合作，对抗国民政府。所采取的政策

pages.en:
May 11, 1937.

-4-

the communist party was natural and correct. Following
the September 18 incident the communist party issued
a declaration demanding the end of civil war and attempted
to compromise with the National Government on three
conditions. These were rejected by Nanking and accepted
by the 19th route army. The Nanking Government
carried out an anti-communist campaign.
On August 1, 1935 the communist
party issued a manifesto declaring formation of an anti-
Japanese and defensive government and in December, 1935
issued another declaration announcing a party resolution
to form a people's anti-Japanese united front. The
declaration won the favour of the people as well as of
a number of the Kuomintang members, but the National
Government still stuck to its old policy. In August,
1936 the communist party again sent a lengthy letter to
the National Government requesting it to convert the
civil war into one against Japan and to reform the
government system in accordance with the three principles
of the late Dr. Sun Yat-sen. The letter won the favour
of many Kuomintang members, but no reply was received
from the Kuomintang.
After the Sian incident the
National Government was faced with a critical situation
and desired internal peace. On February 10, 1937
the communist party sent a telegram to the Kuomintang
setting out the following conditions:-
1. Soviet Government to be made a special
section of the National Government and the red army to
receive instructions from the Military Affairs Commission
of the Nanking Government under the name of the National
Revolutionary Army.
2. Republic be introduced in the area under
the control of the special section.
3. The plan to over-throw the National Government
to be abandoned.
4. The policy of confiscating lands from land
owners to be abolished.
These proposals
were carried out and and removed all doubts
and enabled the formation of an anti-Japanese national
united front between the Kuomintang and the communist
party (To be continued).

1937年5月11日。

-4-

共产党（的做法）是自然且正确的。九一八事变后，共产党发表宣言，要求停止内战，并试图在三个条件下与国民政府妥协。这些条件被南京方面拒绝，但被第十九路军接受。南京政府开展了反共运动。
1935年8月1日，共产党发表宣言，宣布成立抗日救国政府；1935年12月，又发表另一项宣言，宣布党内决议，组建人民抗日统一战线。该宣言赢得了民众以及部分国民党成员的青睐，但国民政府仍坚持其旧政策。1936年8月，共产党再次致函国民政府，请求将内战转化为对日战争，并根据已故孙中山先生的三民主义改革政府体制。这封信赢得了许多国民党成员的好感，但未收到国民党的回复。
西安事变后，国民政府面临危急局势，渴望内部和平。1937年2月10日，共产党向国民党发出电报，提出以下条件：
1. 苏维埃政府改为国民政府的一个特别区，红军以国民革命军的名义接受南京政府军事委员会的指挥。
2. 在该特别区控制区域内实行共和制。
3. 放弃推翻国民政府的计划。
4. 废除没收地主土地的政策。
这些提议得以实施，消除了所有疑虑，促成了国民党与共产党之间抗日民族统一战线的形成（待续）。

NIPPO

S. B. REGISTRY.
No. D 7794
Date 28 / 4 / 37）

FINAL STEP FOR CO-OPERATION BETWEEN NANKING GOVERNMENT
AND COMMUNIST PARTY; JOINT COMMITTEE TO DISSOLVE
RED ARMY

The question of co-operation
between the Nanking Government and the Chinese Communist
Party is drawing public attention as it will bring a
great change to the Nanking Government administration.
The movement for co-operation has been greatly advanced
since Mr. Chang Chung, a member of the Central Executive
Committee, returned to Nanking after holding conferences
with Chow Ung-lai, representative of the Chinese Communist
Party, and other important communist leaders in Shensi.
On April 26 the Central Political
Council held a meeting at which a final decision was
reached regarding the four conditions submitted by the
Chinese Communist Party for co-operation with Nanking.
A few days ago Mr. Chang Chung left for Shensi to reach
a complete agreement regarding the co-operation. According
to information received by certain quarters, one of the
four conditions states that a tentative agreement will
be concluded regarding the dissolution of the Red Army.
For this purpose a joint committee will be formed with
Chow Ung-lai as chairman. The Committee will re-organize
the red army in the present Soviet district and the
re-organized army will remain where it is, as neither
party wishes to see it moved. All Soviet terms used
in the government and the district will be abolished, and
Chu Teh and Mau Shih-tung, leaders of the communist party,
will proceed to Soviet Russia in accordance with the
agreement.

"RECORD OF NATIONAL CRISIS" CONFISCATED

On April 23 the S.M.P. and
the City Government Police Bureau raided a Chinese book
store known as the Reading Life Society located at No.
71 Love Lane and seized 30 copies of a pamphlet entitled
"Record of National Crisis".
On April 26 the First Special
District Court issued an order for the confiscation of the
seized pamphlets, as a result of the trial of the case.
The "Record of National Crisis" was drawing public
attention because of an abusive expression used on page
9.

日期 37年4月28日）

南京政府与共产党合作的最后步骤；成立联合委员会解散红军

南京政府与中国共产党的合作问题正引起公众关注，因为它将给南京政府的行政带来巨大变化。自中央执行委员会委员张冲先生在与中国共产党代表周恩来及其他重要共产党领导人在陕西举行会谈后返回南京以来，合作运动取得了极大进展。
4月26日，中央政治委员会召开会议，就中国共产党提出的与南京合作的四项条件作出最终决定。几天前，张冲先生前往陕西，就合作事宜达成全面协议。据某些方面收到的消息，四项条件之一规定，将就解散红军达成初步协议。为此，将成立一个联合委员会，由周恩来担任主席。该委员会将对目前苏维埃地区的红军进行重组，重组后的军队将原地驻防，因为双方都不希望看到其调动。政府和该地区使用的所有苏维埃术语将被废除，共产党领导人朱德和毛泽东将根据协议前往苏维埃俄国。

“国难记”被没收

4月23日，上海公共租界警务处（S.M.P.）和市政府警察局突袭了位于爱文义路71号的一家名为“读书生活社”的中国书店，查获了30本名为《国难记》的小册子。
4月26日，第一特区地方法院在审理此案后，下令没收被查获的小册子。《国难记》因在第9页使用了侮辱性言辞而引起了公众关注。

April 26, 1937.

NICHI-NICHI

FINAL COMPROMISE BETWEEN NATIONAL GOVERNMENT
AND COMMUNIST PARTY

A special telegram from Nanking
reports that at 10 a.m. April 24 Mr. Chang Chung, member
of the Central Executive Committee, who had returned to
Nanking after holding conferences with Chow Ung-lai,
representative of the Chinese Communist Party, at Sian
to compromise with the latter following the Third
Plenary Conference held at Nanking, passed Kaifung on
his way to Sian to bring about a final compromise
between the Nanking Government and the Chinese Communist
Party. During the last conferences no definite
understanding was reached for re-organization of the
Red Army and abolition of Soviet districts.
Mr. Chang Chung is a member of
the Feng Yu-hsiang clique and the pro-Soviet party as
well as being one of the directors of the Sino-Soviet
Cultural Society.

NIPPO

ECONOMIC ACTIVITIES OF GREAT BRITAIN AND AMERICA
IN CHINA

The Nippo publishes the
following leading articles:-
Among Powers which are exporting
their products to China recent statistics show that
America occupies the highest position. America cannot
overlook the trade activities of Japan and Great Britain
in China and she must compete with them in order to
secure the widest market in China. For this reason,
America recently sent Mr. Pearson, President of the
Export and Import Bank, to China.
As a result of the arrival of
Mr. Kirkpatrick and Mr. Pearson in China, the economic
activities of the Powers concerned will become conspicuous
as well as their political activities to expand their
influence. These activities will not bring any good
to China. The people in the Orient are opposed to such
activities because they will endanger peace in the
Orient. It is to be hoped that the National Government
will be warned against the economic activities of the
Powers in China which will turn China into a colonial
market for their products.

1937年4月26日。

NICHI-NICHI

国民政府与共产党之间的最终妥协

来自南京的特电报道，4月24日上午10时，中央执行委员会委员张冲先生在南京召开第三届全体会议后，为与中国共产党代表周恩来在西安举行的会谈中达成的妥协事宜，途经开封前往西安，以促成南京政府与中国共产党之间的最终妥协。在最近的会谈中，关于红军重组和撤销苏维埃地区的问题未达成明确谅解。
张冲先生是冯玉祥派系和亲苏派系的成员，也是中苏文化协会的董事之一。

NIPPO

英美在华经济活动

《日日新闻》刊登以下社论：
在向中国出口产品的列强中，近期统计数据显示美国占据最高地位。美国不能忽视日本和英国在中国的贸易活动，必须与它们竞争，以确保在中国获得最广阔的市场。为此，美国最近派遣进出口银行行长皮尔逊先生访华。
随着柯克帕特里克先生和皮尔逊先生抵达中国，相关列强的经济活动及其扩大影响力的政治活动将变得引人注目。这些活动不会给中国带来任何好处。东方人民反对这类活动，因为它们将危及东方的和平。希望国民政府警惕列强在华的经济活动，这些活动将使中国变成其产品的殖民地市场。

Shanghai Pao (上海报) (April 24) :-
CHINESE COMMUNIST PARTY SURRENDERS TO GOVERNMENT
With a view to strengthening her
international position, Soviet Russia is compelled to give
up, for the time being, her scheme to bolshevize the world.
The Chinese Communist Party will have to alter their policy
now that support from the internationale is discontinued.
During the recent Third Plenary Session
at Nanking, it was resolved that the communists be granted
a chance to surrender. After this, one clique of the
Chinese Communist Party suggested that they obey the National
Government unconditionally and struggle for national salvation
under the direction of the Government, while the other
clique desired that the National Government should designate
certain Hsiens in the North-West as a special area for the
communist troops and that the Government should immediately
declare war with XX. The first clique was victorious as
a large number of the communists supported the suggestion
that they surrender to the National Government unconditionally.
Sometime ago, Chow Ung-lai (周恩來), Mau Shih-tung (毛澤東)
and Chu Teh (朱德) met in North Shensi and discussed the
future policy of the Communist Party.
The Communist Party in China has now
suspended all activities, and the red band on their uniforms
and the half moon and sickle flag on their hats has also
been taken away. Therefore, there is no special insignia
for the so-called communist troops at the present time.
The connection between the Communist Party in China and
Soviet Russia has been completely severed.
The Chinese Communist Party has thoroughly
understood the policy of the National Government. We hope
that they will observe the Three Principles of the People
and work for the country under the leadership of the
National Government.

《上海报》（4月24日）：
中国共产党向政府投降
为了加强其国际地位，苏维埃俄国被迫暂时放弃其布尔什维克化世界的计划。由于共产国际的支持中断，中国共产党现在不得不改变其政策。
在南京最近召开的第三届全会上，决议给予共产党人投降的机会。此后，中国共产党中的一派建议无条件服从国民政府，并在政府的指导下为救国而奋斗，而另一派则希望国民政府指定西北某些县作为共产党军队的特区，并立即政府对 XX 宣战。由于大量共产党人支持无条件向国民政府投降的建议，第一派获胜。
不久前，周恩来（周恩來）、毛泽东（毛澤東）和朱德（朱德）在陕西北部会面，讨论了共产党的未来政策。
中国共产党在中国现已暂停所有活动，制服上的红带和帽子上的半月镰刀旗也被移除。因此，目前所谓的共产党部队没有特殊的标志。
中国共产党与苏维埃俄国之间的联系已完全切断。
中国共产党已彻底理解国民政府的政策。我们希望他们遵守三民主义，在国民政府的领导下为国家工作。

Hwa Mei Wan Pac dated February 15 :-

CITIZENS FEDERATION'S TELEGRAM TO THIRD PLENARY SESSION

On the morning of February 15, the Shanghai First Special District Citizens' Federation and its various branches sent a telegram containing the following five points to the Executive and Supervisory members of the Third Plenary Session:-

(1) It is known to all that the principal cause of our national crisis is external aggression, lack of military and political unification and weakness of the administrative bureau, as witness the recent uprising in Shensi and Kansu. The Third Plenary Session should devise ways and means to consolidate the foundation of national unification.

(2) The political tutelage by the National Government has lasted ten years. Last year the National Government proposed the holding of a National Citizens' Convention to enable the people to participate in the administration of political affairs. Owing to disturbed conditions, the proposal could not be carried out. The Third Plenary Session should fix a date for the convocation of a National Citizens' Convention so as to strengthen the foundations of our Government.

(3) The uprising in Shensi and Kansu has been settled, yet in view of the fact that the trouble had lasted for more than one month, the remnants of the bandits were able to revive their activities, thereby causing great distress to the people of the two provinces. The Third Plenary Session is, therefore, requested to devise measures for the relief of the distressed people with a view to bringing about peace and order in Shensi and Kansu.

(4) The plight of North China is becoming increasingly dangerous, while the various provinces along the coast are coveted by the aggressor. For this reason, we must strengthen our national defence to resist external invasion. The Third Plenary Session should draw up an estimate for national defence.

(5) Lastly, the Third Plenary Session is requested to accelerate economic reconstruction of the country and improve transportation with a view to improving the living conditions of the people.

The Holmes (Comment) :-

CHINESE KILLED IN MOTOR CAR ACCIDENT

According to newspaper reports, a Chinese was killed during the lunar New Year holidays by a motor car driven by a subject of a friendly nation who was not qualified to drive a car.

If the driver in this case had been a Chinese and the victim a subject of the friendly nation, most probably the residents of Shanghai would have been busily engaged in removing their homes and would not have been able to enjoy the New Year holidays.

1937年2月16日。下午翻译。

2月15日《华美晚报》：

市民联合会致第三届全会的电报

2月15日上午，上海第一特区市民联合会及其各分会向第三届全会的执行委员和监察委员发送了一份包含以下五点的电报：

(1) 众所周知，我国危机的主要原因是外部侵略、军事和政治缺乏统一以及行政机构软弱，最近的陕西和甘肃起义即为明证。第三届全会应制定方法和手段，巩固国家统一的基础。

(2) 国民政府的政治训政已持续十年。去年，国民政府提议召开全国国民大会，使人民能够参与政治事务的管理。由于局势动荡，该提议未能实施。第三届全会应确定召开全国国民大会的日期，以加强我国政府的基础。

(3) 陕西和甘肃的起义虽已平息，但鉴于动乱持续了一个多月，匪徒残余势力得以恢复活动，从而给两省人民造成巨大痛苦。因此，请第三届全会制定救济受灾人民的措施，以实现陕西和甘肃的和平与秩序。

(4) 华北的处境日益危险，而沿海各省正被侵略者觊觎。为此，我们必须加强国防以抵抗外部入侵。第三届全会应编制国防预算。

(5) 最后，请第三届全会加速国家经济重建并改善交通，以改善人民的生活条件。

Holmes（评论）：

车祸中一名中国人死亡

据报纸报道，农历新年假期期间，一名中国人被一辆由某友邦国民驾驶的汽车撞死，该驾驶员不具备驾驶资格。

如果本案中的司机是中国人，而受害者是该友邦国民，上海居民很可能正忙于搬家，而无法享受新年假期。

Made by D.I. Kuh Foo Hwa Forwarded by I. Boyne D.S.S.

With reference to the attached copy of a communist
circular dated February 10, 1937, which was delivered on February
19, by the Post to the Shanghai Football Association, No.119,
Nanking Road, I have to report that the document in question
reproduces a telegram containing proposals purporting to have
been sent to the Third Plenary Session and drafted by the Central
Committee of the Chinese Communist Party calling for co-operation
with the Kuomintang and the National Government.
The problem of reconciliation with the communist-
bandits was, however, fully discussed at the Sixth general meeting
of the Third Plenary Session of the Fifth Kuomintang Central
Executive Committee on the afternoon of February 21 when the
following resolution was passed :-
That until and unless the communist-bandits sincerely
repent their past mistakes, obey the Three People's Principles,
abide by the Nation's laws and strictly adhere to military
discipline, there could be no question of the Central Government
accepting their offer of reconciliation.
The resolution, which was moved by the Presidium,
listed four major conditions under which the Central Authorities
would be prepared to effect a reconciliation with the Red bandits,
which are as follows:-
1) The abolition of the Red Army and its incorporation
into the unified command of the nation's armed forces.
2) The unification of Government power in the hands of
the Central Government, and the dissolution of the
so-called "Chinese Soviet Republic" and other
organizations detrimental to Government unity.
3) The absolute cessation of communistic propaganda

日期：1937年2月23日。
事由：1937年2月19日通过邮政投递至南京路119号上海足球协会的共产党传单。
制作人：督察顾福华（Kuh Foo Hwa） 转呈人：博伊恩（I. Boyne）副警司

关于随附的1937年2月10日发出的共产党通告副本，该通告于2月19日由邮局投递至南京路119号上海足球协会，本人谨此报告，所涉文件转载了一份电报，其中包含据称由中国共产党中央委员会起草并发送给国民党第三届中央执行委员会第三次全体会议的建议，呼吁与国民党及国民政府合作。
然而，在2月21日下午举行的国民党第五届中央执行委员会第三次全体大会第六次全体会议上，充分讨论了与“共匪”和解的问题，会上通过了以下决议：
除非“共匪”真诚悔悟既往错误，服从三民主义，遵守国家法律并严格遵守军纪，否则中央政府绝无可能接受其和解提议。
该决议由主席团提出，列出了中央当局准备与“赤匪”实现和解的四个主要条件，如下：
1) 取消红军，并将其纳入国家武装力量的统一指挥之下。
2) 将政府权力统一于中央政府手中，解散所谓的“中华苏维埃共和国”及其他有损政府统一的组织。
3) 绝对停止与三民主义截然相反的共产主义宣传

Central Registry,
S.M.P. Headquarters,
February 19, 1937.

To
H. M. Myers Esquire,
Central Registrar.

Sir,

Attached handbill purports to have been circu-
lated by the Central Executive Committee of the
Chinese Communist Party and reproduces a telegram
recently sent to the Third Plenary Session of the
Central Executive Committee of the Kuomintang now
meeting in Nanking, in that the Communist Party
proposes that the following be adopted as national
policy.

(1) To stop all civil fighting and concentrate
national resources against foreign aggression.
(2) Freedom of speech and meeting and re-
lease of all political offenders.
(3) A meeting to be held of all parties, fac-
tions and armies for national salvation.
(4) To complete as quickly as possible all
preparations to resist Japanese aggression.
(5) To improve the living conditions of the
people.

In the event of the above being adopted as
national policy, the Communist Party guarantees
to

(1) discontinue its efforts throughout the
country to overthrow the National Government by
force,
(2) to rename the Soviet Government as the
Chinese Republic Special Area Government and the
Red Army as National Revolutionary Army which will
be under the direct control of the Nanking Govern-
ment and its Military Affairs Commission,
(3) to carry out fully within the territory
under the Special Area Government the Min Chu
Principles, and
(4) to discontinue the policy of confiscation
of landowners' land.

In making the above proposals public, the
handbill further seeks the support of the recipient
in the best interests of the nation and people.

For your information please.

Y. O. S.

Translator.

中央注册处，
上海公共租界工部局警务处总部，
1937年2月19日。

致
H. M. Myers 先生，
中央注册主任。

先生：

随附传单据称由中国共产党中央执行委员会散发，并转载了最近发送给正在南京召开的国民党中央执行委员会第三届第三次全体会议的一份电报，即共产党提议将以下内容采纳为国策。

(1) 停止一切内战，集中全国资源对抗外国侵略。
(2) 言论和集会自由，释放所有政治犯。
(3) 召开各党派、各派系及各军队参加的救国会议。
(4) 尽快完成抵抗日本侵略的一切准备工作。
(5) 改善人民生活条件。

如果上述内容被采纳为国策，共产党保证：

(1) 停止在全国范围内以武力推翻国民政府的努力，
(2) 将苏维埃政府更名为“中华民国特区政府”，将红军更名为“国民革命军”，后者将直接受南京政府及其军事委员会管辖，
(3) 在特区政府管辖区域内充分实行民权主义（Min Chu Principles），以及
(4) 停止没收地主土地的政策。

在公开上述提议时，该传单还寻求收件人为国家和人民的最高利益提供支持。

供阁下参考。

Y. O. S.

译者
